note: Address and cached start/final/payment attempt responses are derived personal-data copies. Money and state remain separate; this card does not implement scrubbing or alter checkout immutability.

structures.CheckoutAddressSnapshot: Frozen destination/contact object; customer erase must account for this immutable copy.
structures.CheckoutAttemptResult: Cached payment/cancel operation response, including any derived personal fields.
structures.CheckoutFinalResult: Cached terminal checkout response; may contain derived contact/provider payload copy.
structures.CheckoutStartResult: Cached checkout/payment creation response; may contain contact/provider payload copy.
structures.Sha256Digest: Opaque 32-byte cryptographic digest for integrity/request identity/capability verification; never raw token, body or contact data.

subject.identity_path: checkout_sessions.order_id -> orders.id -> orders.customer_id -> customers.id | or (mailbox-verified) customer_guest_order_links.order_id -> customer_id -> customers.id
subject.null_subject_policy: Guest checkout actor hash does not prove customer identity; use linked verified order ownership only.
